Wykorystane biblioteki

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

Wyczytanie i przegląd danych

```{r}
chess <- read.csv("games.csv")
head(chess, 1)

summary(chess)
```

Czyszczenie danych

```{r}
#cgd - clean games data
cgd <- chess |> filter(rated == "True") |> 
  select(white_rating, black_rating, turns, opening_ply, rated, winner, victory_status, increment_code, opening_eco, opening_name) |>
  mutate(rating_diff = white_rating - black_rating)
```
